# TQ checkpoint guidance (synthetic source 1.0.0)

Use one finite TQ checkpoint to reason about the inventory and publication
failure mechanisms, not a generic all-domain audit. Consume the existing
P09 domain-request/result contract with the accepted P05 context, P07 reference
and unchanged T001-T003. Bind all three accepted QA obligations to the checkpoint.

The actual native performer must state the tested invariant, concrete failure
injection, result, preserved behavior, limitation and next owner. Publish only
observed results after the separately released native work; no preparatory
placeholder can count as a result. P09 summaries never clear P05 independent
review or final A23/A24 acceptance.
